findings.title: Unusual behaviour in nng_repro[16]
findings.summary: nng_repro[16] (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 248 of its 248 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 4960 ms. It stands out in: time waiting on a condition variable (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), CPUs used (higher than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion while waiting on a condition variable, but only loosely (distance 9.74 against 0.847 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed.
